profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker CRNC, with SEC CIK 0001768267. On its own site the company describes itself as delivering conversational and agentic AI-powered user experiences for automotive and beyond, and as providing an interaction and action layer for physical AI. It says its platform combines voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, agentic architecture, and governed execution so that people can communicate with vehicles, machines, and other intelligent systems. It states that its technology has been developed and deployed at automotive scale, where AI must work across languages, in noise, with variable connectivity and constrained hardware.

Named offerings include Cerence xUI, described as a multimodal AI foundation that lets OEMs combine speech, vision, and vehicle data to understand driver intent, and Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection (EVD), which the company says is already deployed in production vehicles. Cerence says EVD detects and localizes more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, identifying approaching emergency vehicles from more than 300 meters away with interior microphones and beyond 800 meters with exterior microphones. The site also describes dynamic speech enhancement for multi-seat in-car environments, demonstrated by Timo Matheja and Stefan Hamerich, and material on Zero Trust architecture and layered AI security developed with Microsoft.

In its reported third quarter results, the company said revenue was up 12% year over year and connected services revenue was up 20% year over year, with operating cash flow of $20M supporting its first-ever share repurchase program. The held record lists no cases for the company and records Massachusetts as a law exposure jurisdiction with a count of 191.
